subject: 2021 Reorganization and Pooled Testing Transition
overview: The School Committee elected its 2021 officers and reviewed health protocols for the return to hybrid learning, including a planned transition to pooled COVID-19 testing.

items.title: Election of 2021 Officers
items.summary: Elected Paulette Van der Kloot as Vice Chair and Melanie McLaughlin as Secretary for the 2021 term.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: Approved minutes from the December 21, 2020 meeting and authorized the payment of bills and payroll.

items.title: Columbus Elementary School Renaming Inquiry
items.summary: Referred a resident inquiry regarding the timeline for the Columbus Elementary School name change to the January 26 agenda.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Dr. Edouard-Vincent commented on national political events, upcoming freshman orientation, and a $24,000 grant from the Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the high school language program.

items.title: COVID-19 Health Update and Testing Protocols
items.summary: Officials detailed re-entry testing for various cohorts and announced a plan to transition the district to pooled testing starting January 26.

items.title: Andrews Middle School Highlights
items.summary: School leaders reported on holiday charity initiatives and the launch of a pilot program for restorative practices.

items.title: English Learners Program Update
items.summary: Reported that Access testing has been delayed until April and reviewed the successful relocation of the elementary newcomer program.

items.title: Winter and Spring Athletics Schedule
items.summary: The Athletics Department presented a modified schedule to complete three sports seasons by July 3 and reviewed a spectator policy for parents.

items.title: Racial Equity Task Force Update
items.summary: The Superintendent provided a status report on the task force's membership and its objective to conduct a district-wide equity audit.

items.title: Family School Partnership Initiative
items.summary: The committee discussed applying for a state pilot program intended to improve district systems for family engagement.
